project.stagesTogether: The stages run together. Each stage shows how many to-dos are open.

2026-11-08-158.title: Continuous projects and the project board
2026-11-08-158.body: A continuous project shows its open to-dos in every stage, with no current stage. The To-dos tab has a View button for List or Board. On a continuous project, the columns of the board are the stages. Drag a to-do to move it to another stage.
